question: How can poison become a means to immortality in this teaching?
premises: Worldly existence is likened to poison.
Those whose vision is empowered by Garuda can use poison as medicine.
Right vision transforms what is normally harmful.
inference: Therefore, those established in the right vision can employ even poison and attain an immortal state.
plain_english: For the destruction of the poison of worldly existence, those whose vision is empowered by Garuda employ poison itself and attain an immortal state.
